## What

Say what this pull request changes, in a few sentences or a short table.

## Why

Say why the change is needed, and why it is done this way.

## How it was tested

Say what you ran and what you saw, and what was not tested.

## Observability

Say how the change shows when it runs: its logs, metrics, traces and alerts. When nothing of it runs, say so.

## Docs

Say which docs changed with the behaviour, or why none had to.

## Follow-ups

List what is left for later, or write "None".
